title: Planned Admittance Route Is a Semantic Front End
summary: The Intention layer fronts the router by producing an ordered, object-rich description of currently plausible routes. It does not call those routes authoritative merely because they were plan-feasible.
why: LLM and heterogeneous compute allocation need one semantic route planner while provider, quota, WLU and placement truth remain live and independently authoritative.
invariants: Meaning remains stable even when current feasibility is INFEASIBLE.
Workload, requirement, candidate resource, WLU and placement objects are retained as objects rather than flattened strings.
The preferred route may change when resources, quota, policy, health or capacity change.
Instrumentation freshness may change preference but never admissibility.
PREPARE_ADMISSION carries revalidationRequired=true for COMPUTE, ALLOCATION, WLU and ROUTER.
evidence_note: Grounded in Generalized Compute Intentions v0.1-dev5 tests: dynamic rediscovery, structured Intention Service bridge, handoff revalidation and Mesh freshness/events.
